experiment_configuration.service_limits:
# Only use with compose.integration.yml and an explicit disposable project name.
services:
  workers:
    hostname: benchmark-workers
    cpus: 6
    mem_limit: 8g
    memswap_limit: 8g
    environment:
      COUNT: ${LOAD_JUDGE0_WORKERS:-8}
      RUNNER_BENCHMARK_TIMINGS: "1"
      RUNNER_CALLBACK_OUTBOX: ${RUNNER_CALLBACK_OUTBOX:-0}
  judge:
    environment:
      RUNNER_BENCHMARK_TIMINGS: "1"
    cpus: 1
    mem_limit: 1g
    memswap_limit: 1g
  mysql:
    # Retained result rows must not consume unreclaimable RAM inside this limit.
    tmpfs: !reset []
    volumes:
      - benchmark_mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    cpus: 1
    mem_limit: 1g
    memswap_limit: 1g
  postgres:
    cpus: 1
    mem_limit: 1g
    memswap_limit: 1g
  redis:
    cpus: 0.5
    mem_limit: 256m
    memswap_limit: 256m
  backend:
    cpus: 2
    mem_limit: 2g
    memswap_limit: 2g
  app_worker:
    environment:
      JUDGE0_REUSE_CONNECTIONS: ${JUDGE0_REUSE_CONNECTIONS:-0}
      WORKER_DISPATCH_CONCURRENCY: ${WORKER_DISPATCH_CONCURRENCY:-1}
    cpus: 0.5
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
  tests:
    cpus: 1
    mem_limit: 1g
    memswap_limit: 1g
  callbacks:
    profiles: [callback-outbox]
    image: internal-judge0-fork-api:integration
    environment:
      POSTGRES_HOST: postgres
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: integration-only
      POSTGRES_DB: postgres
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PASSWORD: integration-only
    cpus: 0.5
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    command: bundle exec ruby -r ./config/environment scripts/callbacks.rb
    depends_on:
      judge:
        condition: service_started

volumes:
  benchmark_mysql:

caveat: Small-sample p99 values are diagnostic, not production guarantees.
